title: Unit 10: Learning for Life: Education, Memory & Nominalization
objective: Mampu menggunakan pola reported speech (passive & active), menguasai kosakata pendidikan tinggi, dan berdiskusi tentang kebijakan pendidikan dengan argumentasi yang terstruktur.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas cara melaporkan perkataan orang lain menggunakan reported verbs dan passive report structures. Kamu akan belajar pola seperti 'Experts think that...' atau 'It is believed that...', serta nominalisasi untuk membuat tulisan lebih formal. Materi ini penting untuk diskusi akademis dan penulisan esai tingkat lanjut.
rules: Reported verb patterns: Subject + reporting verb + that-clause (e.g., 'Experts think that more research is needed')
Passive report structures: It + passive verb + that-clause (e.g., 'It is believed that music helps memory')
Nominalization: Mengubah verb/adjective menjadi noun untuk tone formal (e.g., 'decide' → 'decision', 'expensive' → 'expense')
Hedging expressions: Menggunakan 'seem', 'appear', 'probably', 'are thought to' untuk menunjukkan kehati-hatian dalam klaim

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Menggunakan Infinitive setelah Reporting Verbs
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula salah menggunakan infinitive (to + verb) setelah reporting verbs seperti 'suggest', 'recommend', atau 'decide'. Padahal, kata-kata ini membutuhkan that-clause atau gerund, bukan infinitive.
commonTrap.wrong: The teacher suggested to study Physics instead of Drama.
commonTrap.correct: The teacher suggested studying Physics instead of Drama.

dialogue.context: Joanna, Harry, dan Tanya berdiskusi tentang kehidupan mereka setelah lulus sekolah dan pilihan yang mereka buat.

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: Did they go to university? If not, what are they now doing?
lines.translation: Apakah mereka kuliah? Kalau tidak, apa yang mereka lakukan sekarang?

lines.speaker: Harry
lines.text: What factors helped them make their decision?
lines.translation: Faktor apa yang membantu mereka membuat keputusan?

lines.speaker: Tanya
lines.text: How do they feel now about the decision they made?
lines.translation: Bagaimana perasaan mereka sekarang tentang keputusan yang sudah diambil?

lines.speaker: Joanna
lines.text: I'd disagree. She sounds a bit selfish. I'll rather talk to Harry. He seems the most mature.
lines.translation: Aku tidak setuju. Dia terdengar agak egois. Aku lebih suka bicara dengan Harry. Dia tampak paling dewasa.

speakingLab.context: Mr. Khoirul meminta pendapatmu tentang kebijakan pendidikan tinggi dan apakah semua orang harus kuliah atau tidak.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Do you think everyone should go to university, or are there good reasons not to? What's your view?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think it depends on each person's goals. University is great for certain careers, but not everyone needs a degree to succeed.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's a fair point. Can you give me an example of someone who might benefit more from not going to university?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Sure. Someone who wants to start their own business might learn more from real work experience than from studying theory at university.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Interesting perspective. Now, what about the argument that higher education helps people become more well-rounded and informed citizens?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That's true, but I believe people can also become well-informed through reading, online courses, and life experience without formal university education.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence with the correct reported verb pattern: 'The education minister _____ cutting at least one subject from the school curriculum.'
quiz.explanation: Kata 'recommend' diikuti langsung oleh gerund (verb+ing) atau that-clause, bukan infinitive. Pola yang benar: 'recommended cutting' atau 'recommended that we cut'.

quiz.question: Which passive report structure is correct? 'Scientists ___ that music has beneficial effects on memory.'
quiz.explanation: Dalam kalimat aktif dengan subject jelas (Scientists), gunakan simple present 'believe'. Passive structure 'It is believed that...' digunakan tanpa subject spesifik.

quiz.question: Choose the correct hedging expression: 'Playing music in hospital waiting rooms ___ patients' moods.'
quiz.explanation: Hedging expression 'seems to' menunjukkan kehati-hatian dalam membuat klaim, cocok untuk konteks akademis. Ini lebih ilmiah daripada klaim absolut.

quiz.question: I was very lucky that I _____ a scholarship to do my master's degree.
quiz.explanation: Collocation yang tepat adalah 'won a scholarship' (memenangkan beasiswa). Kata 'took' digunakan untuk courses/exams, bukan scholarships.

quiz.question: Complete with the correct nominalization: 'After graduating, I want to do a postgrad course at Columbia University. It doesn't want to do his master's part-time, he wants to study full-time and finish within a year.' What's the noun form of 'graduate'?
quiz.explanation: Nominalisasi dari verb 'graduate' adalah noun 'graduation'. Ini digunakan untuk membuat kalimat lebih formal: 'After graduation' lebih formal dari 'After graduating'.

quiz.question: Which sentence uses the correct reporting verb pattern? 'The headteacher...'
options: Let's discuss this more before making a decision
suggested discussing the matter before deciding
suggested to discuss the issue first
quiz.answer: suggested discussing the matter before deciding
quiz.explanation: Verb 'suggest' harus diikuti gerund (verb+ing), bukan infinitive. Pola: 'suggest doing something' atau 'suggest that someone do something'.
